newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ukraine says will step up privatisations in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine says will step up privatisations in 1997.

text.p: Ukraine plans to spend the rest of 1997 privatising medium- and large-size companies in the food processing, oil refining, chemical and machine-building sectors, the acting head of the State Property Fund said on Tuesday.

"In the next six months we will finish privatising food processing companies with the exception of firms which produce wine and spirits," Volodymyr Lanoviy said in an address to an "Investment Window for Ukraine" conference in Frankfurt.
"We will also speed up privatisation of oil refineries and will start on chemical and machine-building firms," he added.

Lanoviy said the 1997 programme on privatisation, passed recently by parliament, foresaw the start of privatisation for 1,400 companies -- with plans to list shares of four hundred of them on Ukrainian stock exchanges this year.
The Ukrainian government is still forbidden from privatising 5,300 enterprises considered strategic to national security under a veto placed by parliament, Lanoviy added.
